description: Op 7 R_TXM statements (P6-ANON plan §4, D15; pq-zether.md §8.1 op 7): every built (M, auditorOn) of each id with one real leg (123,456) at a position that varies by shape and decoy legs (0), plus a two-real-leg row, an all-decoy row and a group-boundary row (real legs 3 and 4 in groups 0 and 1). ids: the proofSystemIds whose built leg counts contain M (PQZL {1, 2, 4, 8}, PQZH {1, 2, 4}). header: as statement_transfer.json with word 192 = recipientsHash = keccak256(UA_0 || ... || UA_{M-1}) (32-byte words of objects.uas) and word 320 = M; auditorOn = 1 iff pk_a. objects: keys by KeyGen seed (pks: leg order), T = Enc + Trivial(plus_trivial), out: the multi-group Enc (D13): group g encrypts its legs (j / 4 = g), then (g = 0) pk_f with value_f, then (auditor on) pk_a once per leg of the group, from seed_enc_g = seed_enc (g = 0) or SHAKE256(SCAAS-PQZ-ENC-GROUP-V1 || seed_enc || be4(g))[0..32), ctr = its counter. memo (§5.4, CTR-PQZ-23): salt || ((u8(auditorOn) || u8(M) || (be8(a_j) || UA_j)_j) XOR ks), key = HKDF-SHA256(IKM key_seed, no salt, info PQZ/memo/v1 || chainUid || token(20) || fromUA || be4(sendCounter) || salt)[32], ks = HKDF-Expand-SHA256(key, PQZ/memo/ks/v1, 2 + 40 M); memoHash = keccak256(memo). memo_open: memo open (the sender's recovery) on edited memos (resize, flip [byte, bit]) of the case, result = (auditorOn, [amount, UA]) or none. stmt = the PQZL-id bytes (PQZH: bytes 32..63 replaced); stmt_keccak / auth_digest per id; entry_ref as op 1.
